# ghost/navy-fleet-battle

Navy Fleet Battle (F-Droid): classic sea battle against the computer. Start a game, fire at cells A1 to J10 and read the turn and the ships left. Offline, no account.

Deterministic phone automation for the Ghost in the Droid engine. Replays at zero LLM tokens.

## Install

```bash
ghost skill install ghost/navy-fleet-battle
```

## Run

```bash
ghost skill run ghost/navy-fleet-battle open_menu --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/navy-fleet-battle new_game --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/navy-fleet-battle fire --device <serial> --param cell=<cell>
ghost skill run ghost/navy-fleet-battle fire_many --device <serial> --param cells=<cells>
ghost skill run ghost/navy-fleet-battle get_state --device <serial>
```

## Actions

- `open_menu`: Open the Navy Fleet Battle menu
- `new_game`: Start a new Navy Fleet Battle game
- `fire`: Fire at B5 in Navy Fleet Battle
- `fire_many`: Fire at A1, C3 and E5 in Navy Fleet Battle
- `get_state`: What is the Navy Fleet Battle status?
